answer: Because the terrace weight is recomputed from the raven history each close, the spiral audit shows the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 2 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 33% of full weight. Running a farm hence buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
